result:
Comments are in: signed-in readers can post, delete and report comments on a post, and a comment is hidden once three different users report it. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8 tests, including 6 new ones) and the full `bunx guren gate` all pass.

**What happens when a post is deleted.** The new tables have cascade-delete foreign keys. SQLite only applies those when foreign keys are switched on, and the app doesn't reliably switch them on. So `PostController.destroy` deletes the post's comments and their reports itself before deleting the post.

**Choices to know about:**
- **Hidden comments.** They are only left out of the post page. The comment and its reports stay in the database for the later review screen.
- **Repeat reports.** A second report by the same person answers 204 and adds nothing. A unique index on (`comment_id`, `user_id`) also guarantees one row even if two reports arrive at the same moment.
- **Comment text.** Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed before the 1–2000 character check, the same way post titles are. A comment of only spaces is rejected.
- **Who can delete.** The comment's author or the post's author. Anyone else gets 403 and the comment stays.

**Changes:**
- `db/schema.ts` defines the `comments` and `comment_reports` tables, and a new migration in `db/migrations/20260929134443_add_comments/` creates them.
- New models `Comment` and `CommentReport` (the hide threshold of 3 is a constant in `Comment.ts`), plus `CommentPolicy`, `CommentValidator` and `CommentResource`. The policy is registered in `AuthorizationProvider`.
- A new `CommentController` handles `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id` and `POST /comments/:id/report`. All three are behind the existing `auth` middleware in `routes/web.ts`, so guests are sent to `/login`.
- `PostController.show` adds a `comments` prop (oldest first, with author `{ id, name }` and an ISO `createdAt`, hidden ones left out). The `post` prop is unchanged.
- The `posts/Show` page lists the comments, has a comment box for signed-in users, and shows Delete where the viewer is allowed and Report otherwise.
- `tests/CommentController.test.ts` covers the guest redirect, ordering and authors, body validation, who can delete, report deduplication and hiding, and cleanup when a post is deleted.
